$: Where the version lives, enumerated once so it is not rediscovered under release pressure. The whole tool is one file, so `files` is one entry -- but the enumeration is the point, not the length.
$not-listed: ROADMAP.md's `## 0.1.0 -- Records anything, from anywhere` and versioning-overrides.md's `0.1.0 -> 0.1.1` example are historical markers, not version-bearing fields. Bumping either would make it false.

files.$: The only field that must BECOME the new version.

todos: Cut the changelog with the changelog verb: changelog_log op:"release" version:"{NEW}" date:"{TODAY}". It closes [Unreleased] into a dated section and opens a fresh empty one. Mechanical -- it moves text that already exists and writes no prose.
